Review.B15: Total historical D&A is provisionally assigned to disclosed PPE/finite-intangible pools by carrying weights; forecast uses declining balance with half-period additions. Hidden intangible detail remains in other balances; no claim of sourced depreciation lives.

Review.B18: Where note detail is available, finance leases are reclassified into refinanced debt and nonmarketable investment components into the carrying-value bridge. Operating leases remain operating. Future asset additions are cash funded; no new finance leases are assumed.
Review.B19: Default distributions are zero to retain cash for capital spending; analyst controls may change this. No automatic debt/cash plugs. Review.B20: Diluted weighted-average shares, or net income divided by rounded consolidated diluted EPS when the count is not on the face statement, are a valuation proxy; no separate award claim. Review.B21: Forecast dates use the reported fiscal year-end and a provisional 52-week or calendar-year extension. Annual-only cases start with a full forecast year.
Review.B22: Terminal reinvestment is growth times closing operating capital; future excess cash is not added again. Human financial approval is false.
Review.B23: Reported TTM earnings remain unadjusted in this baseline, including one-off gains; the weekend brief separately bridges guidance to analytical earnings. This DCF is an editable mechanics baseline, not a target price.
Review.B24: A constant growth rate over the whole forecast is not management guidance or a segment turnaround forecast. Retained cash, no buybacks/dividends or net new borrowing, fixed diluted-share proxy, constant debt refinancing; no distribution return is modeled.
Review.B25: Risk-free rate, ERP, beta, debt rate and asset-life assumptions are provisional sensitivity inputs. Debt and minority interest use carrying-value proxies.
